representation.proofBoundary: Git source cuts and lexical path/blob checks, NOT a full formal semantic equivalence or production test result
representation.pathEvidenceTuple: Each pair is [changed tracked path, relation of the commit result to the opposite frozen Main cut]. Sources are re-checkable with Git at sourceCut SHAs.
